Hymn 268: Come, All Whose Souls Are Lighted
Time Signature: 4/4

This is hymn number 268 titled "Come, All Whose Souls Are Lighted" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Lowell Mason and the lyrics were written by Reginald Heber.
